name: Bedrock Stance
description: Sink into a low wide stance with qi running to the soles so the body takes a blow like a rooted boulder.

name: Foundation Palm
description: Drive a palm from the settled stance so the whole standing weight travels into the target.

name: Stout Step
description: Move one broad pace at a time and keep the weight low so no shove can turn the step.

name: Pillar Kick
description: Stamp a straight kick from the hip with the leg stiffened like a stone column.

name: Bedrock Guard
description: Meet a charge with a braced frame so the attacker's force breaks back along their own arm.

name: Foundation Strike
description: Turn the hips and send the weight through the fist so a single blow shakes the whole of the target.

name: Bedrock Hammer
description: Bring a two-handed blow down with the full mass of the stance and earth qi to break shields and ribs.

name: Unyielding Mass
description: Hold the body as an immovable mass and push back every blow that lands until the foe's own arms tire.

name: Sharp Tremor
description: Snap one short tremor through the ground to jar the target's guard and loosen their hold.

name: Quake Step
description: Step on the crest of a small tremor so it carries the body a pace past the foe's strike.

name: Shaken Guard
description: Let the arm tremble against an incoming blow so its force scatters across the forearm.

name: Stamp Knuckle
description: Stamp the lead foot as the fist lands so the ground answers and the blow gains the shock.

name: Lurching Quake
description: Pitch the earth in a sudden lurch that sends the target stumbling toward the user.

name: Rumbling Fist
description: Strike with a fist that carries a rolling shake into the target's body and fogs their balance.

name: Quake Roll
description: Send a rolling quake outward from the user to knock down all who stand on the open ground.

name: Seismic Break
description: Gather qi in the earth for several breaths then split it with one violent shock that cracks the ground over a wide front.

name: Quake Lock
description: Keep a steady quake running under a group so none of them can plant a foot or draw a clean breath.

name: Column Rise
description: Raise a short stone column at the user's side and take a stroke on its face.

name: Stone Pole
description: Pull a pole of stone from the ground and jab it hard into the foe's midsection.

name: Upright Stone
description: Stand a thick slab on edge between user and foe to break the line of a thrust.

name: Pillar Lean
description: Raise a stub of stone beneath the foot and push off it to cross a short gap.

name: Monolith Hand
description: Sheathe the fist and forearm in stone so the blow lands like a standing column falling.

name: Pillar Thrust
description: Drive a rod of stone up from the earth to strike the target beneath the guard.

name: Stone Column
description: Raise a broad column that shelters the user and anyone standing close behind.

name: Lifting Column
description: Push a pillar up under a foe and hold them aloft with their feet off the ground.

name: Monolith Fall
description: Raise a great column with the qi field then topple it onto the foe with the weight of a toppled tower.

name: Pillar Press
description: Lay a standing stone on the foe's shoulders and press down steadily until they kneel.

name: Layer Slip
description: Slide the upper soil over the layer beneath so the foe's stance slips out from under them.

name: Stratum Read
description: Press a palm down and feel which layers beneath hold firm and which will slide.

name: Shift Soil
description: Slide a patch of soil sideways beneath the feet to carry the user out of a strike.

name: Rock Seam
description: Open a narrow seam in the ground that catches the foe's foot and wrenches the ankle.

name: Shear Layer
description: Shear one layer of ground against the next so the shock slams up into the target's legs.

name: Strata Carry
description: Ride a moving sheet of ground forward and let the earth itself carry the body across open space.

name: Splitting Strata
description: Rip the layers apart in a wide line so jagged ledges heave up under everyone standing on them.

name: Tectonic Drift
description: Set a broad slab of ground drifting so foes are carried away while the user steps free.

name: Twin Buttress
description: Raise two short posts at either side of the body so a blow from either flank is stopped.

name: Mated Strike
description: Hit with both fists in quick succession so the second lands as the first draws the guard.

name: Twin Tread
description: Take two short steps as one so the body crosses the gap and settles in the same breath.

name: Pillar Pin
description: Raise a short pillar against each shoulder of the foe to hold both arms still.

name: Twin Pillars
description: Raise a matched pair of pillars that pin a foe between them and shield the user from the front.

name: Matched Spires
description: Raise two spires of stone from the ground that cross at one point and spear a single target.

name: Echo Pillar
description: Raise a second pillar a heartbeat after the first so a blow that breaks one meets the other.

name: Pillar Crown
description: Bring one pillar down on the foe and raise the other under their feet so they are crushed between the two.

name: Colossus Pair
description: Raise two huge pillars in turn then bring them against each other so the foe between them is flattened.

name: Dive Stone
description: Throw a stone high and let it dive onto the foe from above where the guard is thin.

name: Spread Stance
description: Throw both arms wide and settle low so the body covers ground on every side after a drop.

name: Swoop Step
description: Launch from the planted foot in a long low bound and drop back to earth on the target.

name: Talon Rock
description: Hook a pointed rock downward into the foe's shoulder like a raptor's grasp.

name: Falling Cobble
description: Drop a heavy cobble from above the head onto the foe's helm or shoulder.

name: Stooping Slab
description: Tilt a raised slab and let it drop edge-first with the user's weight on top of it.

name: Plunge Boulder
description: Hurl a boulder straight upward and let it plunge on the target as the user steps aside.

name: Talon Landing
description: Leap high and land with both heels so the ground bursts out around the user in a ring.

name: Raptor Drop
description: Rise on a spike of earth then fall on the foe with a stone-clad fist and the whole weight of the descent.

name: Skyfall Boulder
description: Lift a great boulder on gathered qi then drop it among a clump of foes so it bursts into shards.

name: Twin Footing
description: Set both feet on separate slabs of hardened earth and brace against a shove from the front.

name: Pair Base
description: Lay a second layer of qi under the first so the body bears more weight without strain.

name: Matched Palm
description: Strike with both palms level at once so the force lands in two places on the chest.

name: Side Settle
description: Slide to one side and let the earth firm at both feet before the next move.

name: Paired Tamp
description: Tamp the ground twice in rhythm so the target's feet are shaken out of their plant.

name: Mirror Stone
description: Hold a polished stone before the body to turn aside a glancing blow with a smooth face.

name: Double Base
description: Spread the stance onto two stone foundations that bear the user's weight and steady every blow thrown.

name: Twin Footfall
description: Drop both feet in a single heavy beat so two rings of shock spread and meet in the crowd.

name: Counter Mass
description: Set a stone mass against the incoming blow so its weight swings back through the striker.

name: Foundation Pair
description: Anchor user and nearest ally on one shared bed of stone so both stand firmer and strike heavier.

name: Twin Bedrock
description: Reach two roots of stone into the earth so the user and the ally beside them stand against any shove.

name: Paired Stone Fall
description: Drop two slabs of rock from either side onto one spot and burst the ground around the impact.

name: Gale Brace
description: Lean into a rising gale with the feet rooted and let it break across the planted frame.

name: Stone Oath
description: Speak a sworn word and press it into the ground so the stance holds until the word is broken.

name: Windward Step
description: Step into the wind and plant so firmly that the gust drives the foe back instead.

name: Scouring Rock
description: Let the wind pick up a flung rock and carry it into the foe's face at speed.

name: Held Gale
description: Catch a blast of wind on a braced stone face and throw it back across the foe's stance.

name: Sworn Marker
description: Set a stone marker beneath the feet as a sworn line and stand firmer for as long as it stays whole.

name: Gale Splitter
description: Throw a ridge of rock into the wind so it splits the gale and the shards fan out among the foes.

name: Sworn Footing
description: Bind the stance to an oath and let no wind or shove move the feet while the vow stands.

name: Aimed Palm
description: Strike along a line the user has fixed through the stone so the palm lands exactly where aimed.

name: Taken Bearing
description: Read the direction of a distant foe through the stone and fix a line to their position.

name: Heading Step
description: Take a firm step along the fixed line and bring the whole body behind the next strike.

name: Slant Stance
description: Plant on the chosen line and let a blow glance away along it rather than strike across.

name: Straight Course
description: Drive a spike of stone in a dead-straight line through the ground to the target's feet.

name: Bearing Lock
description: Hold a foe to the fixed line with clamps of stone so they cannot move off it.

name: Stone Scythe
description: Drag a long stone edge along the fixed line and strike everything that stands upon it.

name: Bedrock Bearing
description: Fix the line through bedrock itself and strike along it so the blow cannot be turned or evaded.

name: Bearing Fall
description: Gather a mass of stone on the fixed line and let it fall on the foe at the end of it.

name: Unmoved Blow
description: Strike without stepping back or aside and let the foe's return blow break against the stance.

name: Planted Stand
description: Dig in against a shove and press qi into the soil until the push dies.

name: Oath Heel
description: Swear to hold and drive the heels deep so every strike made from the stance carries more weight.

name: Firm Pace
description: Advance one pace and never retreat it so the line of stance moves only forward.

name: Pledge Knuckle
description: Close the fist on the vow and drive it forward with the weight of a held breath.

name: Locked Stance
description: Set the feet and let qi lock the knees so the stance cannot be swept or turned.

name: Unyielding Oath
description: Hold the sworn stance through a long exchange and grow harder against each blow that lands.

name: Immovable Press
description: Lean the unmoved frame into the foe's guard and press until their feet slide back.

name: Clinging Stone
description: Spread held qi into the soil about the user so every foe within it moves as if through wet stone.

name: Oath Mass
description: Make the whole body a sworn mass that holds a line against a charge and drives the charge back.

name: Unmoved Crown
description: Rise from the unmoved stance in a single blow that carries all the held weight into the foe's head.
